mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_LOGIN_FAILURE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND LOCKED_UNTIL > SYSTIMESTAMP
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_LOGIN_FAILURE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND FAILED_AT >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_LOGIN_FAILURE SET LOCKED_UNTIL = SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10' MINUTE WHERE FAILURE_ID = ( SELECT MAX(FAILURE_ID) FROM MEMBER_LOGIN_FAILURE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MEMBER_LOGIN_FAILURE WHERE FAILED_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
